=== Possible Mrs Glascoe, Ormond Quay shopkeeper ===
Mrs Glascoe’s shop on Ormond Quay, Dublin, is reported with shutters taken down and several panes broken. Passers-by alarmed the house; she requested police protection, which the paper says was refused.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/1050062764/ Freeman’s Journal, 1787-10-09, p.4].</ref>

The report gives neither her forename nor her husband. The Ormond Quay watchmaker and the Dublin Thomas Glasco marriages of 1773, 1779 and 1785 do not yet establish a single household or identify this shopkeeper.

This may concern [[Duffy-6026]]. Ann (Duffy) Glasco has an uncertain 1756 Dublin birth and a recorded Thomas Glasco spouse. No Ormond Quay shop, given-name or household connection.
